scope: Initial source-backed inventory for workspace/session, worklanes/panes, command routing, and coding agents required by issue 7.

entries.behavior: Decode, migrate, preserve, and export ordered schema-v3 windows, worklanes, columns, panes, selections, frames, titles, CWDs, commands, colors, and bookmark origins.
entries.user_impact: Without exact recipes, Linux cannot restore the workspace users created in Zentty.
entries.test_plan: Add staged-product import, action mutation, clean-exit export, and exact relaunch assertions under controlled X11 and Wayland.

entries.behavior: Atomically save debounced live snapshots and synchronous clean-exit snapshots while rejecting stale generations and filtering meaningless defaults.
entries.user_impact: Workspace changes would otherwise disappear at ordinary shutdown or race into an older snapshot.
entries.test_plan: Drive real GTK actions, wait for the real debounce or clean-exit path, and inspect and relaunch from the produced envelope.

entries.behavior: Use the lifecycle marker to distinguish clean restore preference from mandatory crash recovery, consume successful restores, and report unusable snapshots.
entries.user_impact: A crash would lose all current worklanes or repeatedly relaunch a corrupt snapshot.
entries.test_plan: Kill the installed product after a persisted mutation, relaunch it, assert exact restored topology, and distinguish corrupt-snapshot failure from success.

entries.behavior: Create, select, remove, reorder, and keyboard-navigate ordered worklanes while preserving stable identities and active selection.
entries.user_impact: Worklanes are Zentty's primary unit of parallel coding work.
entries.test_plan: Preserve the delivered real menu/action, Ctrl+Super+Arrow and pointer drag reorder routes, including stable identity, active selection, overflow and automatic reveal. Add controlled Wayland pointer drag and persisted-order relaunch evidence before promoting this feature from PARTIAL.

entries.behavior: Show and edit optional worklane titles and colors using source trimming, empty-name, menu, and visual treatment behavior.
entries.user_impact: Users cannot distinguish concurrent tasks reliably without durable names and color cues.
entries.test_plan: Add real modal Save, Cancel, and empty-title interaction receipts plus persistence round trips.

entries.behavior: Render compound worklane cards with nested pane summaries, current context, progress, review state, and human-attention state.
entries.user_impact: A terminal list without status and attention loses the at-a-glance coding-agent workflow that defines Zentty.
entries.test_plan: Feed real agent events through the terminal and IPC paths and assert the visible card's progress and attention transitions.

entries.behavior: Represent ordered columns and vertical panes; split, focus, resize, arrange, and move panes within and across worklanes according to PaneCommand semantics.
entries.user_impact: The structural port now provides Add Pane Left, directional focus, all source width/height arrangement presets, golden focus ratios, reset layout, stable reflow, contextual move UI, and persisted real-terminal geometry. Direct divider resizing, keyboard resize commands, and cross-window moves remain incomplete.
entries.test_plan: Add source-equivalent draggable dividers and four keyboard resize commands using real Ghostty cell metrics, then cover direct divider drags, minimum sizes, cross-window moves, and source top/bottom cross-worklane focus behavior. Current controlled X11/Wayland coverage retains four real PTYs while exercising Add Pane Left, directional focus, all width/height presets, golden ratios, reset, GTK reparenting, and persisted geometry.

entries.behavior: Close panes with source focus fallback and restore recently closed panes with CWD and command context.
entries.user_impact: Undo Close Pane now restores a recent user-closed local pane with a fresh identity, original slot/weight, custom title, CWD, command prefill, focus, and real Ghostty surface. Agent-specific resume, scrollback archive presentation, missing-CWD fallback, and broader close-source coverage remain incomplete.
entries.test_plan: Current controlled X11/Wayland coverage closes and restores a real local PTY, asserting fresh identity, CWD, command prefill, focus, geometry, persistence, and one-model/one-surface/one-child ownership. Add running/exited/active/inactive close-source combinations, missing-CWD fallback, scrollback archive presentation, and agent-resume restoration.

entries.behavior: Preserve pane working directory, launch and last-run command, custom title, remembered title, and last-activity title using source normalization rules.
entries.user_impact: Restored terminals would open in the wrong project or lose the context that identifies their task.
entries.test_plan: Restore real shells in controlled temporary directories and prove titles and command metadata survive mutation and relaunch.

entries.behavior: Drag panes and worklanes with source hit testing, split zones, insertion feedback, and cross-worklane outcomes.
entries.user_impact: Initial Linux users can use named move actions, but lose direct spatial manipulation until this is ported.
entries.test_plan: Port deterministic drop resolution before using real GTK pointer sequences against actual pane and sidebar widgets.

entries.behavior: Expose Ghostty-backed pane search through the pane search HUD and command routing.
entries.user_impact: Long coding and agent transcripts are impractical to navigate without terminal search.
entries.test_plan: Qualify the installed product and reviewed light/dark/fractional-scale visuals. Physical X11 covers search, navigation, selection-to-find, typed-query hide-with-remembered-highlights, selection-query close-and-clear, live-query/corner retention, and PTY focus; controlled Wayland covers the same real Ghostty core and named routes but its headless Weston lacks virtual-keyboard injection.

entries.behavior: Resolve and execute command-palette results through the same availability and action-routing paths as menus and shortcuts.
entries.user_impact: Many Zentty workflows would be present but undiscoverable or unreachable on Linux.
entries.test_plan: Port deterministic result resolution, then open the real palette and invoke worklane, pane, and agent commands through named GTK actions.

entries.behavior: Provide Linux-native GTK actions, accelerators, context menus, and accessible names for source commands without copying AppKit menu implementation details.
entries.user_impact: Linux desktop users need native discoverability, keyboard routing, and accessibility rather than AppKit-specific menu objects.
entries.test_plan: Continue the source command inventory beyond the delivered contextual pane-action slice, map remaining commands to named GTK actions and accelerators, and add semantic accessibility inspection without replacing real pointer coverage.
entries.alternative_or_blocker: GTK4 actions, accelerators, popovers, and Linux accessibility APIs replace AppKit menus and key equivalents.

entries.behavior: Preserve Ghostty rendering, VT and terminal ownership while shipping Zentty's compatible Ghostty defaults, terminfo, themes, resource lookup, configuration reload, and performance diagnostics without a second emulator or PTY owner.
entries.user_impact: Every higher-level Zentty workflow depends on ordinary terminal applications rendering and behaving exactly as real Ghostty terminals rather than a partial replacement.
entries.test_plan: Run real terminal conformance and representative interactive TUIs in staged Ghostty surfaces and PTYs, validate packaged terminfo/themes/config lookup, and retain focused ABI/input/lifecycle tests and mutations beneath those product scenarios.

entries.behavior: Support physical and composed keyboard input, modifier/layout changes, mouse reporting, selection, clipboard ownership, URL and file drag/drop, middle-click selection paste, selection autoscroll, smooth scrolling, and stable background scrollback.
entries.user_impact: Agent-aware UI is unusable if shells, editors, pagers, multiplexers, selection, or scrolling are subtly damaged by the host application.
entries.test_plan: Drive real physical keys, IME, pointer, selection, clipboard, drag/drop, scrollback and representative TUIs through staged Wayland/X11 surfaces into real PTYs; mutation-test routing and gesture precedence.

entries.behavior: Recognize SSH pane identity, show a remote marker, and safely upload pasted or dropped local files/images to the resolved remote host before inserting the escaped remote path.
entries.user_impact: Remote users otherwise receive misleading local paths or lose Zentty's source workflow for moving images and files into an SSH session.
entries.test_plan: Use a disposable real SSH server, real pasted/dropped files and clipboard images, checksum the upload, assert the escaped remote path reaches the PTY, and cover hostile names, cancellation, collision and partial failure.

entries.behavior: Capture, persist, edit, update, import/export, unlink, and restore reusable bookmark and preset workspace shapes including topology, proportions, paths, titles, colors, live commands, launch targets, and supported agent context.
entries.user_impact: Bookmarks are the source feature for intentionally reusable setups; ordinary crash/session restore does not replace them.
entries.test_plan: Save through the real product, quit, restart, restore from the actual XDG bookmark file, and assert real topology, PTY CWD/command, git context, dimensions and linkage; cover symlinks, migration, corruption and stale paths.

entries.behavior: Create and restore multiple windows and transfer a live pane across worklanes/windows or into a new window without recreating its Ghostty surface, PTY, process, scrollback, title, CWD, or dimensions.
entries.user_impact: Source workflows reorganize live long-running agents and shells across windows; replacement sessions would destroy the state being organized.
entries.test_plan: Move a real live PTY process and terminal surface through mouse/action routes between lanes and windows under Wayland/X11, prove PID/surface/scrollback identity, then restart and verify the persisted ownership.

entries.behavior: Hold to open the live Worklane Peek overview, navigate neighboring lanes by keyboard, click and spatial swipe, show project and attention context, shield terminal input, and focus the chosen lane in the active window.
entries.user_impact: Worklane Peek is Zentty's fast visual context switcher and a major part of the worklane UX, not decorative animation.
entries.test_plan: Retain the physical Tab-duration contract: Tab release before 200ms traverses even while Control stays held, while Tab remaining down beyond 200ms opens Peek. Preserve repeated-key, spatial-arrow, real horizontal-wheel, Escape, Control-release, selected-pane HUD and exact-card-click X11 routes. Add controlled precision-touchpad/natural-direction evidence, multiple-window targeting, attention context, reduced-motion transitions, and proof that every neighboring-lane terminal preview remains live before promoting this feature from PARTIAL.

entries.behavior: Reproduce source-accurate icon chrome and hierarchical sidebar controls, rows, badges, context menus, tooltips, accessible names, resize and pinned/overlay visibility rather than retaining developer text-button scaffolding.
entries.user_impact: The source interaction model and information hierarchy are core product behavior; a toolbar of text actions is not Zentty UX.
entries.test_plan: Extend the delivered contextual pane actions, keyed row reconciliation, real overflowing-sidebar reveal, and pinned/hidden/hover-overlay modes with annotated source screenshot coverage, semantic accessibility inspection, persisted visibility, reduced-motion transitions, controlled Wayland hover/drag, and proof that every chrome interaction preserves real terminal focus.

entries.behavior: Maintain back/forward navigation, recent pane and recent command history, and exact-pane routing from attention, search, menu/fleet and palette actions across windows.
entries.user_impact: High-pane-count workflows need reversible navigation and direct return to recently used or attention-requesting work.
entries.test_plan: Preserve the delivered browser-style Back/Forward stacks, real Alt+Left/Right and chrome-button routes, adjacent-pane traversal, and Ctrl+PageUp/PageDown worklane actions. Add recent-command UI, attention/search/menu/fleet/palette routing, real keyboard worklane traversal in both display backends, multiple-window history, hidden-column reveal, and mutation coverage before promoting this feature from PARTIAL.

entries.behavior: Search pane-local scrollback or globally across every pane and agent state in the current window, present global results in the sidebar, and navigate the exact visible or hidden match without losing terminal context.
entries.user_impact: Searching a single pane cannot replace Zentty's advertised ability to find output and agent state across a busy window.
entries.test_plan: Generate unique output in real PTYs across visible and hidden panes, drive pane/global find controls and next/previous, and assert result order, reveal, selection and exact focus in both compositors.

entries.behavior: Provide configurable Clean Copy, exact Copy Raw, automatic clean-copy override, URL/path cleanup, and Copy as Markdown while preserving prose, commands, indentation, blank lines, columns, IPv6 and functional URL parameters.
entries.user_impact: Clean Copy is a named public Zentty feature; corruption or omission forces users back to manually repairing terminal output.
entries.test_plan: Maintain source regression/golden corpora and mutation tests, then select output in real terminals, invoke each real UI/action path, and assert exact desktop clipboard bytes and settings behavior.

entries.behavior: Resolve worklane repository, branch and remote context, refresh after relevant work, show project icons, associate pull requests, display CI/approval/conflict/age/error state, refresh manually/adaptively, and open the branch or PR remotely.
entries.user_impact: Branch, project and review context are how users distinguish similar agent panes and understand whether work is ready without switching terminals.
entries.test_plan: Use real temporary repositories/remotes and a controlled forge/gh-compatible fixture, drive refresh/open actions, and assert source-priority badges, icons, URLs, large-repo bounds and error states; mutation-test precedence and parsing.

entries.behavior: Discover ordered built-in and custom Open With targets, resolve the focused pane directory or project file, launch the configured primary or selected Linux file manager/editor/tool, and skip missing targets diagnostically.
entries.user_impact: Opening the active project in an external editor or file manager is a documented daily workflow even though Finder and AppKit launch APIs are macOS-specific.
entries.test_plan: Discover real installed `.desktop` applications plus controlled custom launchers, drive chrome/palette actions, and verify the exact canonical path/URI and missing/hostile-target behavior.
entries.alternative_or_blocker: Use XDG desktop application discovery and the desktop portal or explicit executable launch; supply Linux file-manager/editor defaults instead of Finder/Xcode-specific targets.

entries.behavior: Detect and attribute passive, output-reported and container-published development servers to panes/projects, normalize and rank URLs, ignore noisy ports, open the selected server, refresh, and safely stop an owned server process.
entries.user_impact: Agents commonly run alongside servers; Zentty advertises detection/open/control so users can act without hunting ports and process owners.
entries.test_plan: Launch real HTTP listeners from distinct PTYs plus a disposable container, verify attribution/ranking/open/ignore/refresh/stop through the staged product, and cover IPv6, PID reuse, hostile URLs and unrelated processes.

entries.behavior: Discover package scripts, Taskfile, just, make, mise and VS Code project tasks and expose safe dynamic run actions with source naming, origin, ordering, CWD and command behavior.
entries.user_impact: Task runners are a named public feature and connect project files to real repeatable terminal work without adding an IDE.
entries.test_plan: Create real fixtures for every format, drive dynamic palette results in the staged app, prove command and CWD in a real PTY, cover hostile/symlinked files, and mutation-test parsers/deduplication/order.

entries.behavior: Show per-pane root/foreground process identity, CPU history, memory and network usage in a themed accessible diagnostics window with bounded Linux sampling and correct process-tree ownership.
entries.user_impact: The Task Manager lets users identify expensive or stuck work by pane without leaving Zentty or guessing from process titles.
entries.test_plan: Run distinct CPU/memory/network process trees in real PTYs, compare bounded samples to kernel/cgroup data, exercise exit/PID reuse/multiwindow cases through the real window, and mutation-test aggregation/root selection.

entries.behavior: Provide the complete searchable settings surface and secure XDG TOML persistence with defaults, validation, partial reload, last-good state, comment/unknown-key preservation where practical, live watch, and symlink-safe atomic writes.
entries.user_impact: Users need source settings and safe dotfile-friendly persistence; hard-coded behavior or destructive rewrites make the port untrustworthy.
entries.test_plan: Drive all settings sections through the staged UI, externally edit the real config during runtime, restart and inspect normalized state; cover partial/invalid/concurrent/symlink/permission/crash cases and mutate validators/migrations.

entries.behavior: Make the complete command registry bindable with physical-key recording, pass-through when unbound, conflicts, clear/reset, left/right-hand presets, clickable previews, search/categories, import and export.
entries.user_impact: Keyboard-first and fully bindable commands are defining source behavior, including preserving terminal input when an app action is unbound.
entries.test_plan: Record/rebind/conflict/clear/import/export/preset/reset through real GTK settings, then prove bound actions and unbound bytes in real PTYs on both compositor stacks; mutate conflict and resolution logic.

entries.behavior: Resolve bundled and user Ghostty themes/config, live-reload included files, preserve non-theme settings, preview and select themes, opacity, background images, dark/light/automatic modes, platform blur alternative, seeded colors and OpenCode synchronization.
entries.user_impact: Ghostty themes and polished live appearance are advertised product features; Linux must not regress to an unconfigurable embedded terminal.
entries.test_plan: Load real bundled/custom/included configs, drive settings and external reload, inspect actual multiwindow surfaces under dark/light and scaling, cover symlinks/background images/opacity, and mutation-test precedence/healing.
entries.alternative_or_blocker: Use GTK dark/light preference and compositor-supported transparency; expose a documented no-blur degradation where the active compositor provides no safe blur protocol.

entries.behavior: Deliver agent and pane attention through sidebar/chrome, a local inbox, Linux desktop notifications and configurable sound, include actual question/context, clear stale items, and route every action to the exact window/worklane/pane.
entries.user_impact: Surfacing and jumping to agents that need attention is Zentty's central value proposition and cannot stop at an in-pane badge.
entries.test_plan: Emit real events from PTYs in multiple windows, inspect the staged UI and a controlled desktop notification/audio service, activate each route and prove exact PTY focus; cover stale/silent/custom-sound/failure cases and mutations.
entries.alternative_or_blocker: Use the Linux desktop notification portal/service and audio stack while retaining an in-window inbox fallback; Dock-specific badges map to in-app/tray attention where supported.

entries.behavior: Present waiting, running, idle and progress state for agent panes across all Zentty windows, with priority grouping, exact-pane actions, settings and quit, using an always-available in-window surface plus a tray/status-notifier integration where supported.
entries.user_impact: Cross-window agent visibility is lost if Linux treats the macOS menu-bar implementation as having no user outcome.
entries.test_plan: Populate multiple real windows with agent states, inspect priority and actions in the in-app fleet surface and a controlled status notifier, then exercise stale/malformed/window-close cases and mutate summary precedence.
entries.alternative_or_blocker: Provide an accessible in-window fleet status on every Linux desktop and optionally StatusNotifierItem integration where the desktop supports it; do not require a GNOME extension.

entries.behavior: Optionally prevent system sleep while qualifying tracked agents are running and release the Linux inhibitor immediately when work idles, exits, is closed, the setting changes, or Zentty shuts down.
entries.user_impact: Long agent turns can otherwise pause unexpectedly, but an orphaned inhibitor would harm battery and system behavior.
entries.test_plan: Acquire a real desktop/systemd inhibitor from staged Zentty, inspect it across running/idle/exit/close/crash/restart/settings transitions, and mutation-test qualifying-state and lease-release logic.
entries.alternative_or_blocker: Use the desktop portal or systemd-logind inhibitor API instead of macOS power assertions, with explicit capability reporting when neither is available.

entries.behavior: Ship the complete embedded Rust zentty CLI for version and topology discovery, authenticated selection/control, split/grid/layout/pane/worklane/window operations, notifications, server and integration commands with stable aliases, JSON, stdout/stderr and exit codes.
entries.user_impact: Scriptable pane-aware control and hooks are advertised product behavior and the transport used by agent integrations, notifications and teams.
entries.test_plan: Invoke the real staged/installed CLI as subprocesses into a running product over the real Unix socket, exercise every command family/alias/selectors/JSON/errors against real PTYs and windows, then mutation-test parsing/auth/output dispatch.

entries.behavior: Inject pane/instance/CLI/hook context and provide Bash, Zsh, Fish and Nushell shell integration for CWD, activity, wrapper PATH and initial CWD without modifying user config or emitting startup/control-sequence noise.
entries.user_impact: CWD, hooks, CLI routing and clean prompts fail if pane shell integration is incomplete or pollutes terminal input/output.
entries.test_plan: Launch real Bash/Zsh/Fish/Nushell panes, capture exact startup bytes and environment, change CWD/nest shells/run management commands, and assert routing metadata without stray sequences; mutate shell policy/escaping.

entries.behavior: Manage new/close/multiwindow, close-pane/worklane/window and quit confirmation based on real work, fullscreen/display placement and clean shutdown without orphaning PTYs, teardown races, or lost required persistence.
entries.user_impact: Users must be protected from accidentally destroying live agent work while normal Linux window/fullscreen/shutdown behavior remains reliable.
entries.test_plan: Drive close/quit/fullscreen/multiwindow with real live/idle PTYs and agent state, keyboard accept/cancel, background callbacks, restart and crash injection; assert prompts, cleanup and persistence in controlled compositors.
entries.alternative_or_blocker: Map standard macOS Hide/Minimize/Mission Control behavior to GTK/window-manager conventions while preserving confirmation, activation, fullscreen and restored-placement outcomes.

entries.behavior: Expose stable/beta update availability, release notes, trusted install/upgrade and failure-safe rollback through Linux packaging rather than silently dropping the Sparkle-owned source outcome.
entries.user_impact: Users need a visible, trustworthy path to fixes without an in-app updater damaging or bypassing their Linux package ownership.
entries.test_plan: Use a controlled signed package/update repository to test stable/beta discovery, availability UI, success, invalid signature, interruption, offline, rollback and unchanged prior install; mutate state transitions.
entries.alternative_or_blocker: Integrate distribution/package update metadata and user-invoked package-manager upgrade rather than porting Sparkle; preserve channel, visibility, trust, release-note and rollback outcomes.

entries.behavior: Show build/version/commit metadata, docs/source and complete third-party licenses, provide local diagnostics, and enforce Zentty's no telemetry/analytics promise with crash transmission only after explicit user review and consent.
entries.user_impact: A public terminal handling agent content and tokens must disclose its build and dependencies and must never silently export user data.
entries.test_plan: Compare staged/installed resources to the license catalog, exercise About links/metadata, capture all network traffic during ordinary use, explicitly submit a controlled crash payload, verify redaction/consent/opt-out, and mutate completeness/redaction rules.

entries.behavior: Provide opt-in terminal performance overlay, frame/viewport diagnostics and bounded breadcrumbs/signposts that support troubleshooting without materially slowing terminals or exposing commands, output, paths, or tokens.
entries.user_impact: Source diagnostics are needed to investigate rendering and hang regressions, but must not introduce the performance or privacy failure they diagnose.
entries.test_plan: Run representative high-output real terminals with diagnostics off/on, bound overhead and storage, inspect/redact receipts, exercise overlay through the staged app, and mutation-test redaction and metric state.

entries.behavior: Discover agent launches, require integration consent, install or select the approved wrapper or hook, and preserve one-shot restore semantics.
entries.user_impact: Agent hooks must not be silently installed, while approved integrations must work consistently across new and restored panes.
entries.test_plan: Use real agent binaries or deterministic local stand-ins, real shell wrappers and files, and control only the external model response.

entries.behavior: Receive real hook and wrapper events over the local IPC protocol, adapt them into pane status, progress, questions, and attention, and render those states.
entries.user_impact: Without the real event path, Zentty is merely a terminal multiplexer and cannot surface coding-agent progress or questions.
entries.test_plan: Run a real terminal child, wrapper or hook, Unix socket, protocol adapter, reducer, and sidebar; control only the external agent response.

entries.behavior: Support Codex discovery, notify/transcript events, status resolution, questions and approvals, title promotion, write-back, and resume.
entries.user_impact: Codex is a primary supported coding workflow and must expose real progress and human-attention transitions.
entries.test_plan: Preserve the delivered real Codex CLI/PTY/hook/IPC/resume journey, complete hook and notify adapter, and bounded real transcript question extraction including 12-candidate/four-day CWD-scoped discovery and cache identity. Add a controlled real model turn that makes installed Codex invoke the notify callback, then port and product-test source title-driven enrichment/retry, terminal-title/progress reconciliation, interrupt suppression, shell-return clearing, title promotion, and write-back before promotion from PARTIAL.

entries.behavior: Support Claude Code hooks, session correlation, stop-race handling, explicit state, title presentation, questions, and resume.
entries.user_impact: Claude Code users otherwise lose hook-driven completion and attention state.
entries.test_plan: Exercise the real Claude hook command, session store, Unix IPC, PTY, and sidebar with only the remote model response controlled.

entries.behavior: Provide Zentty's hand-rolled tmux compatibility facade for Claude Code agent teams: a bundled tmux shim and CLI route authenticated commands over the running app's Agent IPC socket into existing worklane, pane, layout, terminal-input, capture, and compatibility-store behavior without becoming a second PTY multiplexer.
entries.user_impact: Without the compatibility path, Claude Code agent teams cannot create and control their source-equivalent subordinate pane topology inside Zentty even when ordinary terminals and Claude hooks work.
entries.test_plan: Freeze the source command and alias contract, test Rust parsing/protocol/store logic and mutations, then drive the staged and installed tmux shim as a real subprocess through a private Unix socket into the real Zentty app, Ghostty surfaces, and PTYs. Cover first-split golden geometry, later vertical stacking, leader focus, send/list/capture/select/kill, width restoration, concurrent wait-for clients, restart, corrupt state, permissions, authentication, malformed input, and oversized requests; control only the remote model response.

entries.behavior: Support Gemini hook events, action-required approvals, status, titles, and resume behavior.
entries.user_impact: Gemini users otherwise receive no reliable approval or completion signal outside the terminal text.
entries.test_plan: Preserve the delivered staged wrapper, private merged system-settings overlay, complete local hook mapping, authenticated sidebar approval state, source-compatible resume command, and real Gemini CLI acceptance under controlled X11 and Wayland. Add Gemini terminal-notification Action required/Session complete enrichment, a controlled real model turn that emits the installed hooks, and restored Gemini relaunch/sidebar evidence before promotion from PARTIAL.

entries.behavior: Support OpenCode recognition, status, overlay layout, live theme synchronization, and resume.
entries.user_impact: OpenCode requires terminal/theme coordination in addition to generic agent status.
entries.test_plan: Run a real OpenCode terminal and local theme files, then assert status and theme changes without faking filesystem or PTY behavior.

entries.behavior: Support Amp recognition, plugin installation, launch policy, events, and resume sanitization.
entries.user_impact: Amp remains usable as a terminal CLI initially but lacks Zentty-managed status and resume integration.
entries.test_plan: Use a real temporary Amp configuration and plugin install path plus a real terminal session.

entries.behavior: Support Copilot explicit-hook progress, OSC presentation, status, and attention.
entries.user_impact: Copilot remains usable, but its explicit progress and needs-input presentation is deferred.
entries.test_plan: Run Copilot's real hook, PTY, OSC, adapter, and visible progress and attention path.

entries.behavior: Support Cursor hook installation, hook events, status, attention, and resume.
entries.user_impact: Cursor remains usable, but its hook-driven state is deferred.
entries.test_plan: Run Cursor's real hook installer, terminal, event adapter, and visible status path.

entries.behavior: Support Droid hook installation, event adaptation, task state, status, and resume.
entries.user_impact: Droid remains usable, but task and hook state is deferred.
entries.test_plan: Run Droid's real hook installer, task store, PTY, adapter, and visible status path.

entries.behavior: Support Kimi hook installation, event adaptation, launch passthrough, status, and resume.
entries.user_impact: Kimi remains usable, but hook status and management-command passthrough are deferred.
entries.test_plan: Run the real Kimi CLI help and passthrough paths, hook installer, PTY, adapter, and visible status.

entries.behavior: Support Pi recognition, management-command passthrough, overlay launch policy, status, and resume.
entries.user_impact: Pi remains usable, but Zentty-specific overlay, status, and resume behavior is deferred.
entries.test_plan: Run the real Pi CLI management and agent paths in a PTY and assert passthrough and status behavior.

entries.behavior: Support OMP recognition, management-command passthrough, overlay launch policy, status, and resume.
entries.user_impact: OMP remains usable, but Zentty-specific overlay, status, and resume behavior is deferred.
entries.test_plan: Run the real OMP CLI management and agent paths in a PTY and assert passthrough and status behavior.

entries.behavior: Support Grok hook installation, canonical event re-emission, status, and resume.
entries.user_impact: Grok remains a plain terminal workflow until its hook integration is ported.
entries.test_plan: Run Grok's real hook installer, canonical re-emitter, Unix IPC, PTY, and visible status path.

entries.behavior: Support Antigravity hook installation, canonical event re-emission, status, and resume.
entries.user_impact: Antigravity remains a plain terminal workflow until its hook integration is ported.
entries.test_plan: Run Antigravity's real hook installer, canonical re-emitter, Unix IPC, PTY, and visible status path.

entries.behavior: Support Hermes Agent hook installation, title presentation, status, attention, and resume.
entries.user_impact: Hermes remains a plain terminal workflow until its hook and title integration is ported.
entries.test_plan: Run Hermes' real hook installer, PTY, adapter, title reducer, and visible status path.

entries.behavior: Support Mistral Vibe hook installation, canonical event re-emission, status, and resume.
entries.user_impact: Vibe remains a plain terminal workflow until its hook integration is ported.
entries.test_plan: Run Vibe's real hook installer, canonical re-emitter, Unix IPC, PTY, and visible status path.

entries.behavior: Support Small Harness recognition and the shared explicit status and attention protocol.
entries.user_impact: Small Harness remains usable as a terminal process but lacks Zentty-specific status presentation.
entries.test_plan: Run Small Harness in a real PTY and feed its real explicit status payload through IPC to the visible sidebar.

entries.behavior: Accept custom explicit agent names through the shared IPC/status protocol without falsely applying a known-tool adapter.
entries.user_impact: Unknown tools remain terminal-usable, but explicit custom status is deferred.
entries.test_plan: Send a custom tool's real local IPC payload from a PTY child and prove it remains custom through reducer and sidebar presentation.
